method: Eight alternating interactions per action, click/change to two animation frames; same local Worker and machine. Timings are a local comparison, not a portable hardware guarantee.
changes: One exact semantic resolution cache; attribution does not invalidate it.
Bounded pure shared-Lua query cache and one validation per edit.
Feature cards and settled preview retain their own dependencies.
Drag feedback uses one animation-frame annotation and no pixel readback.
Public sprites are lossless crops of exact reviewed alpha bounds; decoded pixels are verified on every build.
limitations: Settled fitting and validation still run the authoritative Lua VM on the main thread.
Fullscreen availability depends on browser; denied requests use the expanded workspace.
